experiment_data.hypothesis: Reactive intervention baseline: monitoring distinct_1 drop >10% as trigger, switching α from 1.0 to 0.0 at trigger generation. Tests whether downstream-triggered intervention (without canary) can halt collapse, serving as comparison for predictive (canary-triggered) intervention.

spec.command: bash -c "cd /root/autodl-tmp/distrib_canary_collapse && export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache && export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1 && export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 && source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 python -u iterative_train.py --model_name EleutherAI/pythia-410m --seed 42 --data_dir data/wikitext103_5k --steps_per_gen 5000 --num_generations 10 --synthetic_ratio 1.0 --intervention_mode reactive --intervention_metric distinct_1 --intervention_threshold 0.10 --intervention_alpha 0.0 --output_dir results/intervention/reactive_d1_s42"
